xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4630: Dashboard terminal loops on 'Connection lost': herdr streams spawn a bare 'herdr' that the npx PATH can't find

plan.title: Dashboard terminal loops on 'Connection lost': herdr streams spawn a bare 'herdr' that the npx PATH can't find
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: herdr-stream.ts spawned the bare 'herdr' with the dashboard's PATH. A dashboard started via npx has no ~/.local/bin on PATH, so every observe/control/sizing stream died with ENOENT. The dashboard read that as 'controlled by another client; serving it read-only', the observe fallback failed too, and the terminal view looped on 'Connection lost'. The probe still selected Herdr because findHerdrBinary already falls back to ~/.local/bin.
narratives.Proposal: Accept the fix already committed on the branch (38b2252f94d): export herdrSearchDirs() from select.ts (PATH then ~/.local/bin, empty entries dropped), use it for the probe and as the stream child's PATH. Remaining work: assert the sizeHerdrTerminal spawn PATH and env preservation, unit-test herdrSearchDirs directly, and document the shared lookup in docs/TERMINAL-BACKENDS.md and configuration/terminal-backend.mdx. Each item is claimed by a new commit carrying its Item: trailer.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not amend, rebase-rewrite or revert commit 38b2252f94d; the branch is pushed with PR #4631 open
- Do not change the misleading 'controlled by another client; serving it read-only' log for an ENOENT spawn (separate follow-up)
- Do not change probe order, the bare spawned command name, or the deps.binary override
- Do not change PATH in pan up, the dashboard systemd unit, or src/lib/herdr-setup/* (those already spawn a resolved binary path)
- Do not change frontend reconnect/backoff behavior
